messages:
maria: Quick ask — can folks run a small pairwise microbench (H100 / A100 / L40S) on the longctx workload? Need throughput + p99 for batch sizes 1 / 4 / 8, seq_len ~8192. Trying to validate recent kernel changes might've affected L40S p99.
alex: I can do L40S + A100 tonight. Which model + commit should I use?
maria: model: redwood/longctx-ref-70b (q4_0). commit: 9f2b3d8. dataset: longctx-v2/sample-200. Use cache warmup=2, repeats=3. Wanted metrics: avg tok/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, and memory usage.
chen: I'll queue the H100 run. Do we want profiler traces or just the latency histograms?
maria: start with logs + latency hist. If p99 delta > 10% we add a lightweight profiler (nsys) and flamegraph.
ci-bot: bench job queued: https://ci.internal/bench/4587 (H100)
sam-runtime: For reference, the run command I use — drop-in for your runs:
```
bench-run --model redwood/longctx-ref-70b --commit 9f2b3d8 \
  --gpus H100 --batch 8 --seq 8192 \
  --warmup 2 --repeats 3 --dataset longctx-v2/sample-200 \
  --profile nsys --output /tmp/bench-<gpu>
```
alex: L40S run done (3 repeats). quick summary: 
- L40S batch=8 seq=8192: avg 98 tok/s, p99 260ms, mem ~38GB
- A100 batch=8 seq=8192: avg 112 tok/s, p99 215ms, mem ~40GB
(artifacts attached to my bench job)
chen: H100 results in: avg 128 tok/s, p99 175ms, mem ~36GB. CI job: https://ci.internal/bench/4587/results
maria: OK that's pretty clear. L40S p99 is noticeably higher than A100/H100 — suspect kernel fallback or suboptimal kernel selection under longctx.
raj: I can run a quick toggle: KF_DISABLE=0 vs KF_DISABLE=1 to test kernel-fallback. Also try q4_1 quant to see sensitivity.
alex: I can re-run L40S with KF_DISABLE=1 tomorrow morning and include a minimal profiler.
ci-bot: bench job completed: 4587 (H100) — artifacts at https://ci.internal/bench/4587/artifacts
maria: thanks all. I'll collate the numbers into the bench spreadsheet and propose a small canary (L40S kernel selection tweak) if the KF toggle reduces p99 by >15%. Ping me if you find anything surprising :thumbsup:
raj: noted. I'll open a tiny experiment PR with the KF toggle and tag @maria for review.
alex: cool — ping me when PR is up and I'll attach the L40S run and logs.
sam-runtime: I'll add a short note to the runbook about the KF flags and the standard bench args we used, so future runs are reproducible.
